Resolves #19720

Header value menus now show locale-aware Date labels and visible, distinct labels for empty strings, null and undefined. Exact local or UTC midnight uses a date-only label; UTC midnight retains its UTC calendar day across time zones. Other timestamps include local time. The existing pure formatter retains typed keys, counts, sorting and selection, never calls a cell renderer, and reuses its Intl formatters until the locale changes.

Evidence: L3 achieved (real headless Chrome menu rendering, trusted selection and Neural Link Store assertions); L3 required and met. No acceptance residual.

Change class: restoration (`fix`): corrects the existing label contract without adding an API or configurable formatter.

## AC Evidence
| Criterion | Evidence |
| --- | --- |
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/unit/grid/HeaderMenu.spec.mjs` covers local and UTC midnight, parsed ISO date-only fields, timed, seconds-only, milliseconds-only and selected zero-count Date options. `HeaderMenuCoverageNL.spec.mjs` renders the Date column in Berlin and New York. |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: the owning unit file covers `(blank)`, `(null)` and `(undefined)`, distinct raw keys, equal-label collisions and typed selection round trips. Labels were confirmed in the intake comment. |
| AC-3 | CI-covered: scalar fallback and zero cell-renderer calls in the owning unit file. |
| AC-4 | CI-covered: owning unit file and Date-column browser case; outside-CI: local real Chrome run and inspected `date-menu-en-US` image, with stable keys/counts after locale change and only the selected source record remaining. |
| AC-5 | `learn/guides/datahandling/Grids.md`, Column Value Menus, states the label rule. Relative-link validation passed. |

## Deltas from ticket
None substantive. Dates use medium date/time styles, including seconds. Equal rendered labels remain distinct typed options; fractional seconds are not displayed. The per-menu formatter cache follows `Neo.config.locale` changes.

## Test Evidence
Local Node 24.19.0 / headless Chrome: the full owning `HeaderMenuCoverageNL.spec.mjs` suite passed 10/10 in 20.2s on the frozen repaired source, without retries or unexpected worker/page errors. Date cases run in Berlin and New York. Run with `NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT` naming a provisioned Brain checkout and `npm run test-e2e -- test/playwright/e2e/grid/HeaderMenuCoverageNL.spec.mjs --workers=1`. The committed Date cases attach rendered menu images and before/after typed-selection receipts. No hardware or native placement claim.

The reviewed local-midnight-only formatter failed the parsed ISO date-only unit control in both Berlin and New York. The repaired per-menu cache holds three Intl formatters and refreshes on locale change. Equal-label UTC and local midnight values retain distinct keys and selections where their epochs differ.

`agent-preflight`: not hosted here; commit guards and hosted reusable PR baseline provide the available gates. Source-size and relative-link checks passed locally.

# PR Micro-Review

**Class:** contained — one pure formatter in `Menu.mjs` plus its tests and one guide paragraph; no new surface or contract.

**Verdict:** Request Changes

**Glance:** Claim: Date options read as locale dates, `''`, `null` and `undefined` as `(blank)`, `(null)` and `(undefined)`, other scalars unchanged, with no renderer call. Verified at `4e6b2123c7`: `formatValueLabel` caches one date and one date-time `Intl.DateTimeFormat` per `Neo.config.locale` (`'default'` formats in Node), picks date-only by the local getters, and maps the three empties before `String(value)`. The arms named in the AC table exist, and CI is green (51 pass, 1 skip). Bounded repair: only the formatter and its cache field, the two spec files and the guide paragraph change. I also checked whether an invalid Date reaches the new `format` call and throws. It does not: `getOptionKey` → `Filter.getValueKey` rejects it first, in both loops. What I found is below. Date-only data does not arrive at local midnight.

**Findings:**

- [ ] **F-1 (P2): treat exact UTC midnight as date-only, formatted in UTC.** `RecordFactory`'s `date` conversion is `new Date(value)`, so an ISO date string such as `'2026-10-13'` becomes UTC midnight, not local midnight. The local-midnight test misses it. East of UTC the label carries a time: this seat, at CEST+0200, shows "Oct 13, 2026, 2:00:00 AM". West of UTC it names the previous day: `TZ=America/New_York` shows "Oct 12, 2026, 8:00:00 PM". Treat exact UTC midnight as date-only as well, and format that case with `timeZone: 'UTC'`, which gives "Oct 13, 2026" in both zones. Keep the local-midnight rule for dates built in local time. Add a unit arm for `new Date('YYYY-MM-DD')` under a non-UTC offset, and extend the guide sentence. The gap was in my own ticket's prescription: I am amending #19720's AC-1 and The Fix to match.
